scope: Closed quadratic-form and self-adjoint free matter operator supplied by K1366 on L2(T3;H_ps); not the nonlinear Maxwell--matter operator, a source action or a compact-resolvent theorem.

closed_form.form: a_mu(phi)=||grad phi||^2+m^2||phi||^2+mu||Q phi||^2 with m>0 and mu>0
closed_form.closure: The spatial H1 form and the Q graph form are nonnegative closed strongly commuting forms, so their sum is densely defined, closed and strictly positive.
closed_form.domain_reason: Fourier modes of -Delta and circle charge projections strongly commute; for nonnegative eigenvalues a,b, (a+b)^2 is equivalent to a^2+b^2.

spectral_and_causal_control.joint_mode: On spatial Fourier momentum k and charge q, A_mu has value |k|^2+m^2+mu q^2.
spectral_and_causal_control.sharp_floor: A_mu>=m^2 I, with equality on the nonzero constant spatial neutral-charge sector.
spectral_and_causal_control.wave_generator: G_mu=[[0,I],[-A_mu,0]] is skew-adjoint in the energy inner product and generates a unitary group.
spectral_and_causal_control.causal_principal_part: mu Q^2 is internal and zeroth order in spacetime, so the wave principal cone is unchanged on the common smooth graph core.
spectral_and_causal_control.compact_resolvent_boundary: Compact resolvent is false: the neutral charge sector is infinite dimensional across spherical K-types, so constant spatial neutral vectors give infinite multiplicity at eigenvalue m^2.

claim_ceiling: K1366's regularizer defines a closed strictly positive form exactly on K1361's charge graph-Sobolev domain and the self-adjoint free operator -Delta+m^2+mu Q^2 on H2 intersection D(Q^2). It has a sharp positive floor and unitary causal free evolution, but infinite neutral multiplicity prevents compact resolvent and no nonlinear coupled closure or source ownership follows.
